mentions.name: Chameleon
mentions.description: This Chrome extension adds switchable "lenses" to Gmail, with the first lens scrambling email text so that people nearby cannot read the user's screen.
mentions.problem: People nearby can read your screen when using Gmail in public (shoulder surfing).
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Chameleon - a Chrome extension that adds switchable "lenses" to Gmail. The first one scrambles text so people nearby can't read your screen.
